notes.title: 👊💫 Punch your way through Asterix & Obelix - Mission Babylon
notes.notes:
Hello Gauls,

[h3]Dive into an epic, brand-new adventure with [i]Asterix & Obelix - Mission Babylon[/i], available on October 30th![/h3]

[previewyoutube=qqE-_azZdAA;full][/previewyoutube]

This time, our heroes leave their beloved village for a long journey through the Parthian Empire, a faraway kingdom under threat from Roman invasion. Their mission? To save Monipehni, the King of the Parthians, who has fallen victim to a deadly poison brewed by Bahmbuhzeli, a treacherous sorcerer allied with Caesar.

Along the way, they will need to gather the ingredients for the antidote while fending off fierce Roman legionaries. They will also lend a hand to local villagers in exotic and enchanting landscapes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760915/3d083a164f9061b28c1f09b968d7a472deaa32c1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760915/b1700260719f191d0bf967844dd70831e1fb4c86.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760915/e635758dc0f5d20d813ccdef5d41305282493a6c.jpg[/img]

Thanks to their courage, their legendary resourcefulness and plenty of wellplaced slaps, Asterix and Obelix will push back the invaders and prove that the indomitable Gauls are unbeatable, no matter how far from home they may be!

[h3]Experience a story full of humour, epic battles and unforgettable encounters in this thrilling platformer![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760915/9becc77aa75a50137d9cb73f73d231d685ea74b7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760915/848c06f838c9a499418a33b634cdcdf60c65810d.jpg[/img]

[h3]By Toutatis, these Romans are crazy![/h3]

notes.title: 🐏 Asterix & Obelix XXXL: The Ram From Hibernia 🐏 out this Fall
notes.notes:
By Toutatis, these Gauls are crazy!

Following [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492310/Astrix__Oblix__Baffezles_Tous/]Asterix & Obelix: Slap Them All[/url][/i]! and the [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16628/Asterix__Obelix_XXL_Collection/]XXL trilogy[/url][/i], [b]our famous Gauls are back for a brand-new adventure[/b]!

[previewyoutube=wvLYsEpw_PQ;full][Page Steam XXXL si live OU Trailer][/previewyoutube]

[b]This Fall[/b], Asterix and Obelix will take you on a journey through Hibernia for a series of memorable brawls where no dirty tricks will be barred… including smashing your enemies with a barrel! For the very first time, the game will be playable solo and [b]co-op with up to 4 players[/b]! Even the most courageous Romans should hold on to their helmet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40156610/0c2a22fcf9e2cd364801f76f9e1a2a27bb64008e.jpg[/img]

The year is 50 BC. Gaul is entirely occupied by the Romans. Well, not entirely! One small village of indomitable Gauls still holds out against the invaders… Meanwhile, in Hibernia (today known as Ireland) Keratine, chief Whiskitonix’s daughter, is calling Asterix and Obelix to the rescue as they need help to overcome the Roman invasion and bring back her father’s beloved golden ram. For this mission, you’ll control your favorite heroes and [b]use your fists and any surrounding objects[/b] to make your way while throwing Romans in the air! Our two Gauls will also be able to count on their trusty druid [b]Getafix, who’s been working on a new magic potion recipe[/b] for extra power!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1894730/

[b]Wake up the Gaul in you![/b]

notes.title: Microids unveils Asterix & Obelix: Slap them All! Coming fall 2021!
notes.notes:
Romans, pirates and boars beware! The famous Gauls Asterix and Obelix are coming back for a brand new adventure this fall!

Microids is proud to announce the next game in the Asterix franchise! Asterix & Obelix: Slap them All! This 2D beat’em up, in the universe created by René Goscinny and Albert Uderzo, is unveiled today in an action packed video teaser. Get ready to slap left and right before the sky falls on your head!

[previewyoutube=oj63PmB7F7A;full][/previewyoutube]

Be prepared to prove your bravery! Asterix and Obelix: Slap them All! Is set in 50 B.C. Gaul is entirely occupied by the Romans and only one small village of indomitable Gauls still holds out against the invaders. Play as Asterix & Obelix and set sail to the most iconic places in the comic book series while battling Roman legionaries, pirates, brigands and even the dreaded Normans. 

Mr Nutz Studio is in charge of developing Asterix and Obelix: Slap them All! and making this adventure as respectful to the original material as possible. The developers chose to go with an artistic direction very close to the comic book where the characters, the scenery and also the animations are hand drawn. A real tribute to the 2D animated classics and a style that will surely appeal to fans and retro gamers alike.

Unlike the magic potion, the gameplay recipe is pretty straight forward and holds no secrets. Think about the core mechanics defining the beat’em up genre and sprinkle with some local co-op! By Jupiter, by Teutates.. These Gauls are crazy
